      - article:
        - heading "Why do histogram bars touch?" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Continuous values can take any number in an interval, so adjacent class intervals are contiguous.
      - article:
        - heading "The histogram rule" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Plot frequency or frequency density against continuous class intervals. Bar area represents frequency.
      - article:
        - heading "Misconception guard" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Bars must touch, widths matter, and unequal widths require frequency density.
